payload.title: Jev go/no-go: price design A on two pairs
payload.description: Price and cap Jev requests for design A of both cues in docs/sexuality-gender-identity-preregistration.md, limited to nurse/physician and architect/interior designer (about 8,000 requests per cue), per the free-engines-before-paid-ones convention. Get a dry-run price and an agreed cap before sending any request, then run and report against the pre-registered predictions.
